headline.purpose: Primary workspace page titles; 24px mobile override.

table.purpose: Compact rows and headings with tabular numerals.

motion.name: control-state
motion.purpose: Background, colour and border state transitions.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Transition and animation durations when reduced motion is requested.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:10px 18px;min-height:42px;border-radius:8px;font:600 14px/1.4 Inter,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background 160ms;background:var(--brand, #7f56d9);color:var(--surface, #fff);border:1px solid transparent;} .ds-primary:hover{background:var(--brand-hover, #6941c6);} .ds-primary:disabled{cursor:not-allowed;opacity:.55;} .ds-focus:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--brand, #7f56d9); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-focus { transition-duration: 0s !important; } }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-secondary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:10px 18px;min-height:42px;border-radius:8px;font:600 14px/1.4 Inter,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background 160ms;background:var(--surface, #fff);color:var(--muted, #475467);border:1px solid #d0d5dd;} .ds-secondary:hover{background:var(--canvas, #f9fafb);} .ds-secondary:disabled{cursor:not-allowed;opacity:.55;} .ds-focus:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--brand, #7f56d9); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-focus { transition-duration: 0s !important; } }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive action; workspace.css does not define a separate hover colour.
components.css: .ds-danger{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:10px 18px;min-height:42px;border-radius:8px;font:600 14px/1.4 Inter,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background 160ms;background:#b42318;color:#fff;border:0;} .ds-danger:disabled{cursor:not-allowed;opacity:.55;} .ds-focus:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--brand, #7f56d9); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-focus { transition-duration: 0s !important; } }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: White field with a purple border on focus and explicit keyboard outline.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label" for="ds-name">Name</label><input class="ds-input ds-focus" id="ds-name" placeholder="Enter a name" />
components.css: .ds-field-label{display:block;margin:6px 0;font:14px/1.5 Inter,sans-serif;color:var(--ink, #101828);} .ds-input{border:1px solid #d0d5dd;border-radius:8px;padding:10px 12px;min-height:42px;color:var(--ink, #101828);background:var(--surface, #fff);font:14px/1.5 Inter,sans-serif;caret-color:var(--brand, #7f56d9);max-width:100%;} .ds-input::placeholder{color:#667085;} .ds-input:focus{border-color:var(--brand, #7f56d9);} .ds-input:disabled{cursor:not-allowed;opacity:.55;} .ds-focus:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--brand, #7f56d9); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Workspace Navigation
components.description: Current-page purple and quiet neutral hover in the white navigation rail.
components.html: CoursesPrices
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;padding:20px 14px;background:var(--surface, #fff);width:216px;} .ds-nav-link{display:flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px;padding:11px 14px;border-radius:8px;color:var(--muted, #475467);font:500 14px/1.5 Inter,sans-serif;text-decoration:none;transition:background 160ms,color 160ms;} .ds-nav-link:hover{background:var(--canvas, #f9fafb);color:var(--ink, #101828);} .ds-nav-link[aria-current=page]{background:var(--brand, #7f56d9);color:#fff;} .ds-focus:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--brand, #7f56d9); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-focus { transition-duration: 0s !important; } }

components.name: Course Card
components.description: Course-title surface with an independently targetable delete action; example copy is a component label, not product data.
components.html:
Course title

Course description
components.css: .ds-card{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:16px;min-height:244px;padding:24px;background:var(--surface, #fff);border:1px solid var(--line, #e4e7ec);border-radius:12px;font-family:Inter,sans-serif;transition:border-color 160ms,background 160ms;} .ds-card:hover{border-color:#b9a1e7;background:#fefcff;} .ds-card-title{font-size:18px;line-height:1.4;letter-spacing:-.02em;color:var(--ink, #101828);text-decoration:none;} .ds-card-text{font-size:13px;line-height:1.65;color:#667085;margin:0;} .ds-card-delete{padding:5px;border:0;border-radius:6px;background:transparent;color:var(--muted, #475467);cursor:pointer;} .ds-card-delete svg{display:block;width:18px;height:18px;} .ds-card-delete:hover{background:#fef3f2;} .ds-focus:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--brand, #7f56d9); outline-offset: 3px; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-card{transition-duration:0s;}}

components.name: Scrollable Table
components.description: Dense neutral table with tabular numerals and an independently focusable scroll region. Example text has no product meaning.
components.html:
CourseValue
Example item—
components.css: .ds-table-scroll{overflow:auto;max-width:100%;margin:20px 0;background:var(--surface, #fff);border:1px solid var(--line, #e4e7ec);border-radius:12px;} .ds-table{margin:0;width:100%;min-width:600px;border-collapse:separate;border-spacing:0;font:13px/1.5 Inter,sans-serif;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--ink, #101828);} .ds-table th,.ds-table td{padding:13px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line, #e4e7ec);text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;} .ds-table th{background:var(--canvas, #f9fafb);color:var(--muted, #475467);font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap;} .ds-table tr:last-child td{border-bottom:0;} .ds-table tr:hover td{background:#fcfaff;} .ds-focus:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--brand, #7f56d9); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-table-scroll:focus-visible{outline-offset:-3px;}

narrative.overview:
This phrase records the confirmed direction; no additional creative metaphor or visual anti-reference was confirmed. White navigation and content surfaces sit on a quiet grey canvas. Purple identifies selection and primary actions, with pale purple supporting grouped or selected content. Compact, readable forms and tables carry the working interface.

The existing SmartAlp identity is the visual authority. This system documents the implemented refresh, rather than inventing a replacement brand. Preserve the original academy mark and supplied course materials. Desktop is the primary operating context; narrow layouts keep the same workflows accessible.
keyCharacteristics: White working surfaces and a quiet grey canvas.
Purple actions and selection with restrained tonal support.
Inter typography and compact, readable operational content.
A desktop navigation rail with responsive access to the same work.

rules.name: The Functional Accent Rule
rules.body: Use strong purple for actions, selection and focus; use its pale tint to support grouping and contextual emphasis.

rules.name: The Quiet Surface Rule
rules.body: Separate ordinary working regions with tone and borders; reserve the documented shadow for alerts.

dos: **Do** reuse the self-hosted Inter font and the original SmartAlp logo.
**Do** use white working surfaces, quiet neutral dividers and purple actions or selection.
**Do** preserve readable table density, horizontal table scrolling and visible keyboard focus.
**Do** retain role conditions, routes, translations, field names, validation and event handlers when extending the interface.
**Do** use real course materials and actual product data.
donts: **Don't** replace the established academy identity with invented logos or decorative imagery.
**Don't** turn ordinary workspace cards into elevated promotional panels.
**Don't** remove or hide required actions to simplify a layout.
**Don't** introduce fabricated statistics or marketing claims as interface content.
